name: Modal
tagline: Modal is a serverless cloud platform for running Python code — especially AI/ML workloads — at scale with no infrastructure management. Developers define GPU functions in Python and Modal handles scaling, cold starts, and orchestration. It is widely used for running fine-tuning jobs, batch inference, and AI model serving.
